name: Michael Myers
imageAlt: Michael Myers standing at the top of a staircase in official Halloween: The Game artwork
summary: The Boogeyman: the solo hunter in the 1v4 multiplayer match.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: One player takes the role of Michael Myers, stalking Haddonfield while four Civilian players try to survive. Single-player content is also confirmed.

sections.title: Awaiting Launch Details
sections.body: Killer Sense, Stalk, Shape Jump and Shape Dash are described in the official multiplayer overview. Numerical values and tested strategies remain outside the verified evidence.

name: Civilians
imageAlt: Five playable Civilians in the official Heroes of Haddonfield character lineup
summary: The cooperative side of the 1v4 multiplayer match.

sections.title: Confirmed Information
sections.body: Four players take Civilian roles against Michael Myers. The official multiplayer overview describes locating and warning NPC residents, scavenging equipment, helping residents escape and contacting police. The Characters directory lists the confirmed Standard and Deluxe roster.

sections.title: Awaiting Launch Details
sections.body: Detailed abilities, progression values, and tested strategies are not yet verified by this wiki.
